explanation.correct: Amazon Detective automatically collects and correlates log data (such as CloudTrail, VPC Flow Logs, and GuardDuty findings) and builds visualizations to help analyze and determine the root cause of security findings.

distractors.A: AWS WAF filters malicious web requests; it is not an investigation tool.
distractors.B: Amazon Inspector performs automated vulnerability assessments of workloads, not root-cause investigation of findings.
distractors.C: Amazon Macie discovers and classifies sensitive data in Amazon S3, not security investigations.

explanation.exam_pattern: GuardDuty = detect; Amazon Detective = investigate/root-cause analysis of findings.

references: AWS CLF-C02 Exam Guide (Domain 2: Security and Compliance)

questions.stem: Which statement correctly describes AWS Shield Standard versus AWS Shield Advanced?

options.text: Shield Advanced is the free default and Shield Standard is the paid upgrade
Shield Standard is automatically included for all AWS customers at no additional cost for common network and transport layer DDoS protection; Shield Advanced is a paid tier with enhanced protection
Both tiers are paid add-ons that must be purchased before any DDoS protection applies
Shield Standard filters SQL injection and cross-site scripting at the application layer

explanation.correct: AWS Shield Standard is automatic and free for all customers, defending against common network/transport-layer DDoS attacks; Shield Advanced is a paid tier adding enhanced detection, DDoS response team access, and cost protection.

distractors.A: This reverses the tiers — Standard is the free default, Advanced is the paid upgrade.
distractors.C: Shield Standard is free and always on; DDoS protection is not entirely pay-to-enable.
distractors.D: Filtering SQL injection and cross-site scripting is the job of AWS WAF, not Shield Standard.

explanation.exam_pattern: Shield Standard = free, automatic, common DDoS; Shield Advanced = paid, enhanced, response team + cost protection.

references: AWS CLF-C02 Exam Guide (Domain 2: Security and Compliance)

questions.stem: A security team wants to configure and centrally enforce firewall rules — such as AWS WAF rules and AWS Shield Advanced protections — once and have them applied consistently across many accounts in AWS Organizations, including new resources. Which service fits BEST?

options.text: AWS WAF used individually in each account
AWS Network Firewall used in a single VPC

explanation.correct: AWS Firewall Manager centrally configures and manages firewall rules (AWS WAF, AWS Shield Advanced, security groups, AWS Network Firewall, Route 53 Resolver DNS Firewall) across accounts and resources in an organization, including newly created ones.

distractors.B: AWS Security Hub aggregates and prioritizes findings; it does not centrally deploy and enforce firewall rules.
distractors.C: Configuring AWS WAF separately in each account does not provide central, organization-wide enforcement across accounts.
distractors.D: AWS Network Firewall protects traffic in a VPC; it is not the cross-account central policy manager.

explanation.exam_pattern: 'Centrally manage WAF/Shield/firewall rules across many accounts in an organization' = AWS Firewall Manager.

references: AWS CLF-C02 Exam Guide (Domain 2: Security and Compliance)

questions.stem: A company encrypts data at rest in Amazon S3 using AWS Key Management Service (AWS KMS). Which TWO statements are correct? (Choose two.)

options.text: Objects in Amazon S3 cannot be encrypted at rest
AWS KMS key usage can be logged in AWS CloudTrail for auditing
Amazon Macie stores and manages the account's encryption keys
AWS KMS integrates with many AWS services to encrypt data at rest

explanation.correct: AWS KMS is integrated with many AWS services to encrypt data at rest, and KMS key usage (such as encrypt/decrypt calls) can be recorded in AWS CloudTrail for auditing.

distractors.A: Amazon S3 fully supports encryption of objects at rest, including with AWS KMS-managed keys.
distractors.C: Amazon Macie discovers and classifies sensitive data; it does not store or manage encryption keys (that is AWS KMS).

explanation.exam_pattern: KMS = manage keys + encrypt-at-rest integration; key usage is auditable via CloudTrail.

references: AWS CLF-C02 Exam Guide (Domain 2: Security and Compliance)

questions.stem: A manufacturer must keep certain workloads physically inside its own factory for data residency and low-latency control, but wants to use AWS services and APIs with AWS-managed hardware on-site. Which option fits BEST?

explanation.correct: AWS Outposts brings AWS-managed infrastructure, services, and APIs to the customer's own data center or facility, supporting on-premises data residency and low-latency local processing while staying consistent with AWS.

distractors.A: Direct Connect is a private network link to an AWS Region; it does not place compute on-premises.
distractors.B: CloudFront caches content at edge locations for delivery; it does not run workloads inside a customer facility.
distractors.C: Local Zones place AWS infrastructure in large metro areas (operated by AWS), not inside the customer's own facility.

explanation.exam_pattern: 'AWS hardware/services inside MY own data center/facility' = AWS Outposts; 'AWS compute in a nearby metro' = Local Zones.

references: AWS CLF-C02 Exam Guide (Domain 3: Cloud Technology and Services)

questions.stem: A developer building an app for 5G mobile users needs ultra-low latency by placing compute and storage inside telecommunications providers' 5G networks, at the mobile edge. Which AWS offering is designed for this?

explanation.correct: AWS Wavelength embeds AWS compute and storage within communications providers' 5G networks, so traffic from mobile devices reaches the application without leaving the carrier network — minimizing latency for 5G users.

distractors.A: Route 53 is a DNS service; it does not place compute at the 5G mobile edge.
distractors.B: Global Accelerator improves availability and routing over the AWS network, but it does not run compute inside carrier 5G networks.
distractors.D: Local Zones reduce latency for users in a metropolitan area but are not embedded in carriers' 5G networks for mobile-edge use.

explanation.exam_pattern: 'Ultra-low latency for 5G/mobile users, compute inside the carrier network' = AWS Wavelength.

references: AWS CLF-C02 Exam Guide (Domain 3: Cloud Technology and Services)

questions.stem: A small business wants the easiest way to launch a simple WordPress website with a preconfigured bundle and low, predictable monthly pricing, without configuring individual AWS resources. Which service fits BEST?

explanation.correct: Amazon Lightsail is an easy-to-use virtual private server offering preconfigured blueprints (such as WordPress) and bundled, predictable monthly pricing — ideal for simple websites and applications.

distractors.A: Elastic Beanstalk deploys and manages applications but is aimed at developers deploying their own code, not the simplest preconfigured website bundle.
distractors.B: Fargate runs containers serverlessly; it is not a simple preconfigured website bundle with fixed monthly pricing.
distractors.D: Manually configured EC2 requires choosing and wiring up many resources, which is more complex than the simple bundle requested.

explanation.exam_pattern: 'Simplest VPS, preconfigured blueprint (WordPress), predictable monthly price' = Amazon Lightsail.

references: AWS CLF-C02 Exam Guide (Domain 3: Cloud Technology and Services)

questions.stem: A team wants a fully managed AWS-native container orchestration service to run and scale Docker containers, and does not require Kubernetes. Which service fits BEST?

explanation.correct: Amazon ECS (Elastic Container Service) is AWS's own fully managed container orchestration service for running and scaling containers without requiring Kubernetes.

distractors.A: Amazon EKS is the managed Kubernetes service — appropriate when you specifically want Kubernetes, which this team does not.
distractors.B: EC2 Auto Scaling adjusts the number of EC2 instances; it is not a container orchestrator.
distractors.C: AWS Lambda runs event-driven functions, not long-running orchestrated containers.

explanation.exam_pattern: 'AWS-native container orchestration, no Kubernetes needed' = Amazon ECS; 'managed Kubernetes' = Amazon EKS.

references: AWS CLF-C02 Exam Guide (Domain 3: Cloud Technology and Services)

questions.stem: When launching Amazon EC2 instances, what does an Amazon Machine Image (AMI) provide?

options.text: A template containing the operating system and configuration used to launch instances
A load balancer for distributing traffic
A virtual network with subnets and routing
A billing discount for long-term commitments

explanation.correct: An AMI is a template that includes the operating system, and optionally software and configuration, used to launch EC2 instances — enabling consistent, repeatable instance creation.

distractors.B: Distributing traffic is the job of Elastic Load Balancing, not an AMI.
distractors.C: A virtual network with subnets and routing is an Amazon VPC, not an AMI.
distractors.D: Billing discounts come from Reserved Instances or Savings Plans, not from an AMI.

explanation.exam_pattern: AMI = the OS/software template an EC2 instance is launched from.

references: AWS CLF-C02 Exam Guide (Domain 3: Cloud Technology and Services)

questions.stem: A company stores data in Amazon S3 whose access patterns are unknown and change over time. It wants storage costs optimized automatically as objects move between frequent and infrequent access, without retrieval fees or operational effort. Which S3 storage class fits BEST?

explanation.correct: S3 Intelligent-Tiering automatically moves objects between access tiers based on changing usage, optimizing cost with no retrieval fees — ideal when access patterns are unknown or unpredictable.

distractors.B: Amazon EBS is block storage for EC2, not an S3 storage class.
distractors.C: Standard-IA suits data with known, predictable infrequent access, and it charges retrieval fees; it does not auto-tier.
distractors.D: Glacier Deep Archive is the lowest-cost archive for rarely accessed data with slow (hours) retrieval, not unpredictable access needing millisecond reads.

explanation.exam_pattern: 'Unknown/changing access patterns + automatic cost optimization, no retrieval fees' = S3 Intelligent-Tiering.

references: AWS CLF-C02 Exam Guide (Domain 3: Cloud Technology and Services)

questions.stem: A company's Windows-based applications need fully managed shared file storage that supports the SMB protocol and native Windows features. Which service fits BEST?

options.text: Amazon FSx for Windows File Server

explanation.correct: Amazon FSx for Windows File Server provides fully managed shared file storage built on Windows Server, supporting the SMB protocol and native Windows file system features.

distractors.B: Amazon EBS is single-instance block storage, not a shared SMB file system.
distractors.C: Amazon EFS is a shared file system for Linux instances using NFS, not Windows SMB shares.
distractors.D: Amazon S3 is object storage accessed via an API, not an SMB file share.

explanation.exam_pattern: 'Windows / SMB shared file system' = Amazon FSx for Windows File Server; 'Linux / NFS shared file system' = Amazon EFS.

references: AWS CLF-C02 Exam Guide (Domain 3: Cloud Technology and Services)
Amazon FSx for Windows File Server

questions.stem: Which statement about the durability of data stored in Amazon S3 Standard is correct?

options.text: S3 automatically stores data redundantly across multiple Availability Zones within a Region for high durability
Customers must manually copy objects between AZs to avoid data loss
Durability requires moving data to S3 Glacier first
S3 stores each object in only one Availability Zone

explanation.correct: S3 Standard automatically and redundantly stores objects across multiple Availability Zones in a Region, giving very high durability without customer effort.

distractors.B: S3 handles redundancy automatically; customers do not manually copy objects between AZs for durability.
distractors.C: High durability is inherent to S3; it does not require first moving data to Glacier.
distractors.D: S3 Standard spans multiple AZs; single-AZ storage is a specific class (S3 One Zone-IA), not the default behavior.

explanation.exam_pattern: S3 durability comes from automatic redundant storage across multiple AZs in a Region.

references: AWS CLF-C02 Exam Guide (Domain 3: Cloud Technology and Services)

questions.stem: A company runs a production database on Amazon RDS and needs automatic failover to a standby copy in another Availability Zone if the primary fails, to maximize availability. Which RDS feature should it enable?

options.text: A single-AZ deployment with a larger instance

explanation.correct: An RDS Multi-AZ deployment maintains a synchronous standby in a different Availability Zone and fails over to it automatically if the primary becomes unavailable — this targets high availability.

distractors.A: Read replicas are for scaling read traffic (asynchronous copies); they are not the primary mechanism for automatic failover.
distractors.B: DynamoDB global tables apply to DynamoDB, not to an Amazon RDS high-availability deployment.
distractors.D: A larger single-AZ instance still fails entirely if that AZ goes down — no automatic failover.

explanation.exam_pattern: 'Automatic failover to a standby in another AZ / high availability' = RDS Multi-AZ; 'scale reads' = read replicas.

references: AWS CLF-C02 Exam Guide (Domain 3: Cloud Technology and Services)

questions.stem: An application's database is overwhelmed by heavy read traffic from reporting queries. The team wants to offload reads to additional copies of the database to improve read performance. Which Amazon RDS feature fits BEST?

options.text: Vertically scaling to the largest instance and nothing else

explanation.correct: RDS read replicas are additional read-only copies that serve read traffic, offloading the primary and improving read scalability for read-heavy workloads.

distractors.A: ElastiCache can cache reads, but the question asks specifically for the RDS feature that adds read-serving database copies — read replicas.
distractors.C: A Multi-AZ standby is for failover/high availability; the standby does not serve application read traffic.
distractors.D: Vertical scaling raises the ceiling of one instance but does not distribute read load across multiple copies.

explanation.exam_pattern: 'Offload/scale reads with extra copies' = RDS read replicas; 'failover/HA' = Multi-AZ.

references: AWS CLF-C02 Exam Guide (Domain 3: Cloud Technology and Services)

questions.stem: An enterprise has dozens of VPCs plus on-premises networks and wants a single central hub to connect them all, instead of building many individual VPC-to-VPC peering connections. Which service fits BEST?

options.text: VPC peering between every pair of VPCs

explanation.correct: AWS Transit Gateway acts as a central hub that connects many VPCs and on-premises networks through a single gateway, simplifying large-scale connectivity compared with meshes of peering connections.

distractors.A: An internet gateway connects a VPC to the public internet; it does not interconnect many private networks.
distractors.B: VPC peering is one-to-one and non-transitive, so connecting dozens of VPCs requires many connections and does not scale cleanly.
distractors.D: Route 53 is a DNS service; it does not provide network interconnectivity between VPCs and on-premises.

explanation.exam_pattern: 'Central hub connecting many VPCs and on-premises at scale' = AWS Transit Gateway; 'simple one-to-one VPC link' = VPC peering.

references: AWS CLF-C02 Exam Guide (Domain 3: Cloud Technology and Services)

questions.stem: A security-conscious team wants resources in a VPC to reach an AWS service such as Amazon S3 using the private AWS network, without the traffic traversing the public internet. Which capability enables this?

explanation.correct: A VPC endpoint lets resources in a VPC connect privately to supported AWS services over the AWS network, so the traffic does not go over the public internet.

distractors.A: A NAT gateway lets private instances reach the internet for outbound traffic; it still uses the public internet path.
distractors.C: An Elastic IP is a static public IPv4 address; it does not create a private path to AWS services.
distractors.D: An internet gateway provides a path to the public internet — the opposite of keeping traffic private.

explanation.exam_pattern: 'Reach an AWS service privately, no public internet' = VPC endpoint (gateway endpoint for S3/DynamoDB; interface endpoints use AWS PrivateLink).

references: AWS CLF-C02 Exam Guide (Domain 3: Cloud Technology and Services)

questions.stem: An operations team wants a single service to manage a fleet of EC2 and on-premises servers — applying OS patches, running commands at scale, and storing configuration parameters centrally. Which service fits BEST?

explanation.correct: AWS Systems Manager provides operational management of fleets — Patch Manager for patching, Run Command for executing commands at scale, and Parameter Store for configuration data — across EC2 and on-premises servers.

distractors.A: AWS Config records and evaluates resource configurations for compliance, not fleet patching and command execution.
distractors.B: CloudFormation provisions infrastructure from templates; it is not the operational fleet-management and patching tool.
distractors.D: Amazon CloudWatch monitors metrics, logs, and alarms; it does not patch servers or run operational commands.

explanation.exam_pattern: 'Patch, run commands at scale, store parameters across a server fleet' = AWS Systems Manager.

references: AWS CLF-C02 Exam Guide (Domain 3: Cloud Technology and Services)

questions.stem: The practice of defining and provisioning cloud resources from machine-readable template or definition files — so environments are repeatable and version-controlled instead of built by manual console clicks — is called Infrastructure as ______. Enter the missing word.

explanation.correct: Infrastructure as Code (IaC) provisions infrastructure from template/definition files (for example with AWS CloudFormation), making deployments consistent, repeatable, and version-controlled.
explanation.exam_pattern: 'Define/provision infrastructure from templates, repeatable, no manual clicks' = Infrastructure as Code (CloudFormation is the AWS IaC service).

references: AWS CLF-C02 Exam Guide (Domain 3: Cloud Technology and Services)

questions.stem: A team wants a serverless event bus that receives events from AWS services, custom applications, and SaaS providers, and routes them to targets using rules, to build event-driven architectures. Which service fits BEST?

explanation.correct: Amazon EventBridge is a serverless event bus that ingests events from AWS services, custom apps, and SaaS partners and routes them to targets based on rules, enabling event-driven architectures.

distractors.A: Amazon Athena runs SQL queries on data in S3; it is not an event router.
distractors.B: AWS CloudTrail records API activity for auditing; it is not an event bus for application integration.
distractors.D: Amazon SQS is a point-to-point message queue that consumers poll; it is not a rules-based event bus that routes from many event sources.

explanation.exam_pattern: 'Serverless event bus routing events from many sources via rules' = Amazon EventBridge.

references: AWS CLF-C02 Exam Guide (Domain 3: Cloud Technology and Services)

questions.stem: A company wants a generative AI-powered assistant from AWS — one version to help developers build and operate on AWS, and another to let employees ask questions of their enterprise data. Which service provides these assistants?

explanation.correct: Amazon Q is AWS's generative AI-powered assistant: Amazon Q Developer helps build, troubleshoot, and operate on AWS, while Amazon Q Business answers questions grounded in an organization's own enterprise data.

distractors.A: Amazon Rekognition is a pre-built image and video analysis service.
distractors.B: Amazon SageMaker is for building, training, and deploying your own machine learning models, not a ready-to-use generative AI assistant.
distractors.D: Amazon Comprehend is a pre-built natural-language-processing service for extracting insights from text.

explanation.exam_pattern: 'AWS generative AI assistant (for builders and for enterprise data Q&A)' = Amazon Q (Q Developer / Q Business).

references: AWS CLF-C02 Exam Guide (Domain 3: Cloud Technology and Services)
Amazon Q (Amazon Q Developer and Amazon Q Business)

questions.stem: A company is estimating AWS costs and asks how data transfer is generally priced. Which statement best reflects AWS's typical data-transfer pricing?

options.text: All data transfer, in and out, is always free
Data transfer is billed only when using the AWS Management Console
Inbound data transfer into AWS is the most expensive charge
Inbound data transfer into AWS is generally free, while outbound data transfer to the internet is generally charged

distractors.B: Data-transfer charges are based on bytes moved, not on which interface (console, CLI, SDK) you use.
distractors.C: Inbound transfer into AWS is typically free, not the most expensive charge.

explanation.exam_pattern: 'Data IN is generally free; data OUT to the internet is generally charged' — a common CLF cost concept.

AWS - How AWS Pricing Works (data transfer)

questions.stem: Over the years AWS has repeatedly lowered the prices of many services as it grows, gains efficiency, and benefits from greater scale. Which AWS pricing principle does this reflect?

options.text: AWS reduces prices over time as it grows (benefit from AWS's economies of scale)

explanation.correct: A core AWS pricing principle is that as AWS grows, its economies of scale and efficiencies let it lower prices over time, passing savings to customers.

AWS - How AWS Pricing Works (pricing principles)

questions.stem: A company wants machine-learning-based recommendations that identify optimal AWS resources (for example, right-sizing EC2 instances, Auto Scaling groups, EBS volumes, and Lambda functions) to reduce cost and improve performance. Which service fits BEST?

explanation.correct: AWS Compute Optimizer uses machine learning to analyze utilization and recommend optimal resource configurations (right-sizing) for EC2, Auto Scaling groups, EBS volumes, and Lambda functions.
